artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 3-wave plan (3.5h) narrowing latex/typst routing to formatting-only across 13 source-store files.

memory_candidates.content: When a routing/keyword-table fix spans several surfaces, check whether the manifest fields the task description assumes exist actually do. For the latex/typst formatting-only scoping work, the description presumed both extension manifests already declared keyword_overrides; neither did, which flips that half of the work from a narrowing (remove over-broad keywords) into an addition (introduce narrow, high-precision multi-word phrases that short-circuit the hardcoded fallback table). The narrowing then belongs entirely to the hardcoded fallback table and the separate content-based keyword detector, not to the manifests.
